goal: Phase 1: Validate SPARK with HER on Pt(111). Phase 2: Build ab initio NO₃RR on Cu(100) model — first spatial KMC study of nitrate reduction selectivity (NH₃ vs N₂) with GC-DFT parameters

requirements.description: Phase 1: Build and validate HER Pt(111) model (Volmer/Tafel/Heyrovsky, lateral interactions, diffusion, polarization curve)
Phase 2 DFT: Complete ab initio DFT calculations for NO₃RR on Cu(100) — structure optimization (~57), CI-NEB (~14), frequency (~30), GC-DFT (~210)
Phase 2 Code: Implement NO₃RR Cu(100) model in SPARK with 12 surface species, ~15 reactions, lateral interactions, square lattice
Phase 2 Study A: Investigate *NO spatial distribution vs lateral interaction strength and its effect on NH₃/N₂ selectivity
Phase 2 Study B: Compare KMC vs MKM predictions for NH₃/N₂ selectivity vs potential — quantify mean-field error
Phase 2 Study C: Study *NO diffusion rate as tuning knob for selectivity
Phase 2 Study D: Generate polarization curves, Faradaic efficiency vs potential, and partial current densities for NO₃RR
Phase 2: Write manuscript — spatial KMC reveals NO₃RR selectivity mechanism on Cu(100)
requirements.target_journal: ACS Catalysis or Journal of Catalysis

methodology.TS_search: CI-NEB for all steps; BEP fallback for PCET if CI-NEB fails
methodology.barriers: GC-DFT (VASPsol implicit solvation + variable charge + Ω(U) quadratic fit)
